name: script-v3
idea_origin: script-v1 official games: 76.87 (L6, the best DeepSeek game so far) and 13.23 (stuck in L1: a proper fix read as S+ D+ R- cost Output -1 in the month before the review). The script knows when a misreading is costly; it can print the relevant reading cue right before the next reading.
hypothesis: Just-in-time reading cues from the script (before reviews and when HR is uneasy) cut the L1 failures of script-v1 while keeping its upside.
predicted_behaviour: Fewer missed Output/Network costs in review months, fewer R- on polite-but-risky options; most games pass L1 by month 12.
refutation: Games still stuck in L1 or blown up at the same rate as script-v1 (1 of 2).
